title: Naturality of the extended horizontal column projection
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category admitting total complexes of natural-indexed first-quadrant bicomplexes. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism of such bicomplexes, $p\in\mathbb N$, and $m,i\in\mathbb Z$ with $m-p=i$. Write $P_{K,p,m}$ for horizontalExtendedProjection [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection], followed by the canonical identification of the extended column object in degree $m-p$ with that in degree $i$. Then $\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(f))^m\,P_{B,p,m}=P_{A,p,m}\,\operatorname{extend}(f^{p,\bullet})^i$, with composition read left to right.
